quarterly_data.quarter: Yamaichi Electronics TDnet: Construction of Factory 4 in the Philippines (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board resolved on 09-18-2026 to build Factory 4 at its consolidated Philippine subsidiary Pricon Microelectronics (LISP IV, Malvar, Batangas): a three-story building of approx. 30,000 m2 whose main use is assembly of semiconductor test sockets, connectors and other products; total investment approx. JPY 6.5 billion; construction to start February 2027 (planned), building completion and handover end of September 2028 (planned), start of operations in the second half of FY2028 (planned). The company says the group is expanding global production capacity in anticipation of medium- to long-term demand growth in semiconductors, automotive, communications (including AI servers) and industrial equipment. Existing Philippine factories: Factory 1 8,951 m2, Factory 2 6,408 m2, Factory 3 7,484 m2.
quarterly_data.figure: Factory 4 approx. 30,000 m2, approx. JPY 6.5 billion; construction February 2027, completion end of September 2028, operations second half of FY2028
